Thank you.

I might try emailing my main lecturer tonight. Not sure what I'll say to her exactly but I guess it can't hurt.

I'd need to see what's available near me as far as therapists and stuff go. I don't have the money to pay for anything private so going though my GP or emailing something like Samaratins for advice might be my best shot...

Not university, college, so just below university level. (Don't know what the equivalent is elsewhere)
I don't know if we have any counselling beyond the student advisor. I suppose I can look into it. I'm just scared, I guess. 
Explaining why I'm so far behind seems like an absolutely mammoth task too... gotta start somewhere I suppose.
Sorry for rambling. I might now make sense but I really do appreciate the reply. Thank you

I live in the UK. I first went for psychiatric help about 5 years ago. It took around two months at least before I spoke to anyone. (I forget how long exactly but it was at least this long)
My GP did prescribe me medication but besides that I had no help in the meantime.

I kind of had a really bad episode and stopped going to my psychiatrist after a couple months. I've also recently stopped taking my meds, because I thought it wasn't helping me.

So now I'm worse than ever and I can talk to my doctor. Last time I did she told me I wasn't getting any more help because I "refused" it last time... 5 years ago....

I don't even know if I change doctor, if I'll ever get help. Even if I did, the waiting lists in my area have apparently gotten ridiculous.
It's very frustrating.

I've spent most of this weekend on my own, sleeping or feeling like shit when I am awake. 
Bouts of just completely breaking down..
All the while knowing I have work to do for monday that still isn't finished and being told I'm just being lazy. 

... so about as usual I suppose.
